items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was a big hit I think for Cab Calloway. He did that. It was a great song.

ctx.x: [Hendricks sings:] “Hot ginger and dynamite. That’s all they serve at night. Back in Nagasaki where the fellers chew tobaccy and the women wicky wacky woo.” That was a big hit I think for Cab Calloway. He did that. It was a great song.
